This is the function the commit's fix (plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/scripts/validate.py) now calls instead of duplicating the unbounded rendering.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:213 `_model_findings(doc, adapter)` — the validator package's own (already-correct, unchanged) counterpart to the function the commit fixed: validates a document against a contract model and maps each pydantic error to a finding via `_model_error_message()`.
- packages/contract-models/src/analitiq/contracts/shared/common.py:440 `validation_error_summary(e)` — renders a `ValidationError` into a one-line "client-safe" string via `f"{loc}: {err['msg']}"` for every error, using the raw `err["msg"]` with no bounding of any echoed/discriminator value. Used to build `CorruptedPlaceholderBase.from_validation_error` (line 482) for read-contract corrupted-row placeholders — same operation, same unbounded-echo exposure, not touched by this fix.
- packages/contract-models/src/analitiq/contracts/connector.py:187-197 (helper inside the function ending at line 197) — validates a node against `_DERIVED_VALUE_ADAPTER`, catches `ValidationError`, and joins `f"{loc}: {error['msg']}"` per error into a `violation()` detail, again on raw unbounded `error["msg"]`.
- packages/contract-models/src/analitiq/contracts/endpoints.py:3247 `_reject_misargued_function()` — identical pattern to connector.py above: validates against `FunctionExpression`, joins raw `error["msg"]` per error into a `violation()` detail.
  (Note: `RuleViolation`/`violation()`-sourced messages, including these two, are also never routed through `_bounded()`/`_model_error_message()` when they later surface as findings in `_core.py::_model_findings` — `v.message` is used verbatim at line 256.)
